Racecraft

\u2022 Brake in a straight line, then trail off the pedal as you turn in.
\u2022 Hit the apex kerb, then use all the track on exit \u2014 but not past the white line, or you get a track-limits warning.
\u2022 DRS opens the rear wing for ~10-15 km/h when you are within one second of the car ahead at the detection line.
\u2022 ERS boost spends the battery: harvest it by braking hard and lifting.
\u2022 Follow closely and you lose front downforce (dirty air) but gain a slipstream on the straights.
